title: Seasonal Vegetable Pappardelle
subtitle: with vegetable juice and king oyster mushroom
description: Fresh pappardelle tossed with roasted and blanched baby vegetables, king oyster mushroom and a butter-enriched fresh vegetable juice sauce.

steps.text: Grate the carrots, apple, 0.5 clove of garlic and celery on a box grater and squeeze through a cloth to make the vegetable juice.
Heat the oven grill. Boil the baby fennel, turnip and carrots in salted water until slightly tender, transfer to a tray, add the cherry tomatoes and season with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Roast in the middle of the oven for about 15 minutes until charred outside and cooked inside.
Trim the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 3 cm pieces. Blanch in boiling salted water for 3-4 minutes, then move to ice water to stop the cooking.
Blanch the broccolini, snow peas and fresh peas for 2-3 minutes.
Cook the pappardelle in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain, keeping a little of the cooking water.

Heat a pan with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and sear the sliced king oyster mushroom for 40 seconds each side. Add 1 sliced garlic clove and the sage and fry for 30 seconds. Add the roasted and blanched vegetables and toss for about 1 minute.
Add the vegetable juice and cook over high heat for 2-3 minutes until slightly reduced. Add the butter, season, and stir until the butter melts into the sauce.
Add the pasta with a little cooking water and toss until it absorbs the sauce. Plate, garnish with fresh herbs and serve.
